name: spo-export-sites-with-custom-script-enabled
title: SharePoint Online - Export Sites with Custom Script Enabled
shortDescription: This PowerShell script connects to the SharePoint Online Admin Center using certificate-based authentication and audits all SharePoint Online site collections to identify sites where Custom Script is enabled. The results are exported to a timestamped CSV report for audit purposes.
longDescription: This script connects to the SharePoint Online Admin Center using certificate-based authentication and audits all SharePoint Online site collections to identify sites where Custom Script is enabled. The results are exported to a timestamped CSV report containing key site metadata for audit purposes.
